sections.Overview: Houdini is a name known and respected around the world and is one that is associated with greatness. This legendary figure is now celebrated with the premier machine from American Pinball. Help Houdini perform his greatest tricks, be part of his movies, participate in a seance, and go on secret missions.

sections.Frequently Asked Questions:
What is the intended playfield pitch for Houdini? Designer Joe Balcer likes to see the playfield pitch at 6 degrees, that is obtained by having the leg levelers all the way up (no threads showing between the bottom of the leg and the foot) What is the fuse rating for the fuses on the coil driver boards? There are 4 fuses, the fuses for the Brown, Red and Blue lines are 6.3Amp SlowBlow. The fuse for the Black line is 4 ASB. What transistor do you use on the coil driver boards? It is an IRL540N, N channel FET. My Scoop takes several attempts to eject the ball. watch this video https://youtu.be/wL9W80SuabE and perform the adjustments. I am unable to hit all 3 targets with the skill shot. Download the Service Bulletin #3 from our website under Support/Resources and perform the adjustments. How many pinballs are in Houdini? Houdini uses 6 pinballs. How do I update Houdini to the latest code? First you need a USB stick of at least 4 Gig, Formatted as FAT32. Download the game package from the website , copy onto the USB drive (make sure the package name doesn’t change) Plug into the game with power on and follow the onscreen directions. How do I create a Custom Message on my game? Video: https://youtu.be/8fpDKsQIHA4
